Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Knee pain, injury 2 years prior.
Comparison: [REDACTED].

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Alignment is anatomic.  No acute fracture. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion with mild synovial proliferation. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complex tear of the body, posterior horn and root. Maceration and extrusion of the body. Mild reactive edema adjacent tibial plateau along the medial joint line. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Progression of diffuse high grade cartilage loss with areas of full-thickness cartilage loss along the weight-bearing femoral condyle and tibial plateau.  

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defect.  

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Redemonstration of cartilage loss and full-thickness fissuring of the patella. Some increased cartilage loss of the trochlea. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Periligamentous edema which may represent low grade sprain or reactivate edema from medial meniscus tear.  
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild quadriceps insertion tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Patella tendon: Mild patellar tendinosis. No tendon tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad.  No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 14 mm. 

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
Nonspecific prepatellar soft tissue edema. No soft tissue mass. 
Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION: 
1.	[REDACTED]. 
2.	Medial and patellofemoral compartmental chondrosis, progressed from prior. 
3.	Periligamentous edema about the medial collateral ligament which may represent low grade sprain or reactivate edema from medial meniscus tear.
4.	Small left knee effusion with synovial proliferation.

Erhaltene Artikulation im linken Kniegelenk. Knochenmarksödem im Tibiaplateau sowohl lateralseitig als auch medialseitig und in der Eminentia. Ansonsten altersentsprechendes Knochenmarkssignal. Patella zentriert stehend. Moderate Chondropathie am unteren Patellapol mit osteophytärer Ausziehung dort (5/22). Insbesondere medialseitig an der Trochlea auch tief greifende Chondropathie, teils mit chondralen Ossifikationen (7/16) und Delamination über ca 8 mm (5/21). Femorotibial medialseitig vollständig aufgebrauchter Knorpelschicht. Deutliche Osteophyten peripher. Der Innenmeniskus am Hinterhorn deutlich substanzgemindert, in erster Linie nach Innenmeniskusteilresektion. Am lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment großflächige oberflächliche Chondropathie mit fokal tief greifenden Anteilen der lateralen Femurkondyle in der Hauptbelastungszone (5/22). Auch hier deutliche osteophytäre Ausziehungen. Bei aus dem Röntgen vorbekannter meniscealer Kalzifikation Signalanhebungen des Außenmeniskus in der Pars intermedia mit minimaler schräg an die Oberfläche verlaufender Fissur (4/19). Das vordere Kreuzband massiv aufgetrieben und mit deutlicher T2 Signalanhebung. Hinteres Kreuzband unauffällig. Kollateralbandapparat intakt. Geringer Gelenkerguss. V. a. freie Gelenkkörper posterolateral (3/120). Punktförmige Suszeptibilitätsartefakte am Innenmeniskus (3/94), DD bei perioperativen Metallabrieb. Fabella. Unauffällige Darstellung der umgebenden Muskulatur und Subkutis. Plica mediopatellaris Sakikabara Typ A. Baker-Zyste.

Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena prikazuju se uznapredovale OA promjene femorotibijalnog i
femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Denudacija tibijalne i kondilarne hrskavice medijalnog kompartmenta FT zgloba.
Patela je lateralno subluksirana (Wiberg 1) uz vidljivu gotovo potpuno reduciranu debljinu
artikulacijske hrskavice femoropatelarnog zgloba, osobito lateralne fasete patele i kondila
femura gdje je vidljiva hondromalacija IV. stupnja uz manji areal subhondralnog koštanog
edema. Vidljivi su rubni osteofiti femoropatelarnog zgloba.
Sitna osteohondralna lezija posteriornog dijela lateralnog kondila femura.
Više degenerativnih subhondralnih cističnih promjena zglobnih tijela FP zgloba te medijalnog
platoa tibije, najveća posteriorno dimenzija 8 x 12 mm.
Prednji križni ligament je mukoidno degeneriran.
Stražnji križni ligament je zadebljan s vidljivim intrasupstancijskim povišenjem intenziteta signala
fokalna mukoidna degeneracija.
Sitna ganglion cista neposredno uz hvatište stražnjeg križnog ligamenta za tibiju promjera oko 5
mm.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno posljedično degenerativnim promjenama.
Prati se stanje po kompleksnoj ruptutri stražnjeg roga i trupa medijalnog meniska na
degenerativnoj podlozi uz ekstruziju meniska. Uz medijalni plato tibije vidi se okrugla lezija
promjera do 6 mm intenziteta meniska - flap rupturiranog meniska?
Distenzija posteriornog segmenta zglobne čahure medijalno.
Uz ventralni korijen lateralnog meniska vidi se slobodno zglobno tijelo niskih intenziteta signala
dimenzija 7 x 4 mm - kalcifikat?
Bakerova cista aksijalno dimenzija oko 21 x 20 mm. Umjereni izljev u zglobu.
Nešto tekućine uz hvatište tetive m. sartoriusa za femur (tenosinovitis).
Supkutani edem infrapatelarno i edem Hoffine masti.
Manja subhondralna cista glavice fibule promjera 6 mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Artrosis.
Hallazgos:
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
El menisco lateral es de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y cuerpo del menisco medial que impresiona
contactar la superficie articular sugieran una rotura, no desplazada. Moderada extrusión meniscal
difusa.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa del compartimento femorotibial
medial con mínimos cambios óseos secundarios del cóndilo femoral medial y proliferaciones
óseas periféricas.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la región central y posterior del compartimento
femorotibial lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de distribución difusa de la articulación patelofemoral
con proliferaciones óseas periféricas y discretos cambios óseos secundarios.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales. Tendón rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso,
bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Rotura del menisco medial con moderada extrusión meniscal.
Avanzados cambios degenerativos de los compartimentos femorotibial medial y patelofemoral.
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 y 3 del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Leve derrame articular con discreta sinovitis difusa.
Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There are focal high grade chondral defect (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.1*1.1 cm), corresponding posterior weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.2*intact5 cm) and non weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about intact5* intact7 cm). There is no subchondral edema.  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact. There is suspected chronic partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. There is tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligament complexes are intact. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some amount of left knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion. -- Focal high grade chondral defect at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about 1.1*1.1 cm), corresponding posterior weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about 1.2*intact5 cm) and non weight-baring lateral femoral condyle (about intact5* intact7 cm), left knee.  
 -- Suspected chronic partial tear of the posterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
 -- Some amount of left knee effusion.

Prikazane koštane strukture primjerene su morfologije. Povišeni su intenziteti signala u području
medijalnog kondila femura, medijalnog platoa tibije te dijela tibije u području interkondilarnih
eminencija u smislu koštanog edema. Prikazana zglobna tijela primjereno su uzglobljena.
Potpuni gubitak hrskavice u području medijalnog kompartmenta femorotibijalnog zgloba
(hondromalacija IV°), a u lateralnom dijelu su vidljivi izmijenjeni intenziteti signala te redukcija
debljine u smislu hondromalacije III°. Formirani veći rubni osteofiti FT zgloba - uznapredovale OA promjene. Hondormalacija patele II° uz formirane rubne osterofite zglobnih tijela - OA promjene.
Prednji križni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu
mukoidne degeneracije. Stražnji križni ligament je primjerenih intenziteta signala i održanog
kontinuiteta. Ganglion ciste uz dorzalne dijelove oba križna ligamenta.
Lateralni menisk bez znakova rupture, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala u smislu degenerativnih
promjena.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga i tijela medijalnog meniska s ekstruzijom cijelog meniska.
Lateralni kolateralni ligamenti je primjerenih intenziteta signala, održanog kontinuiteta.
Medijalni kolateralni ligament je održanog kontinuiteta, izmijenjenog intenziteta signala te
distendiran.
Uredan prikaz tetive popliteusa, iliotibijalnog trakta i pes anserinus.
Tetiva kvadricepsa i patelarni ligament su izmijenjenih intenziteta signala u području insercije na
pateli u smislu degenerativnih promjena, održanog kontinuiteta.
Patelarni retinakulumi održani.Manja količina izljeva u suprapateralnoj burzi te u dorzalnom dijelu
koljenskog zgloba. Bakerova cista CC promjera do 32 mm.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE LEFT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Left knee pain
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the left knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. Trace Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: Diffuse high-grade partial-thickness cartilage loss with superimposed foci of full-thickness chondral fissuring with subchondral cystic change and marrow edema.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Focal high-grade chondral fissuring at the inferomedial trochlea and trochlear notch.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Thickening of the medial collateral ligament, likely reflecting scarring from prior injury. No edema to indicate an acute injury.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis with intrasubstance signal alteration at the medial insertion.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 9 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:

1. Moderate medial compartment and mild patellofemoral compartment chondrosis.
2. Mild distal quadriceps tendinosis.
3. No meniscal tear.

Findings:  Moderate knee joint effusion. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact medial meniscus. Degenerative maceration of the anterior horn and to lesser extent body of the lateral meniscus. Associated 7 mm anterior parameniscal cyst. Normal vertebral popliteus tendon, pes anserine tendons, distal iliotibial band and distal biceps Hermiston tendon.  Intact extensor mechanism. No evidence of fat pad impingement. The patella is lateralized relative to the femoral trochlear groove. Normal TTâ€“TG and patella tendon ratio.  Low-grade chondral thinning in the lateral tibiofemoral compartment. Relatively well-maintained medial tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage. Diffuse full-thickness chondral loss along the lateral femoral trochlea surface.  Conclusion:  Moderate knee joint effusion. Degenerative maceration of the anterior horn and to lesser extent body of the lateral meniscus with an associated parameniscal cyst. High-grade chondropathy along the lateral femoral trochlea surface.
